$schema_note: One entry per dataset feeding the vocabulary package. tools/vocabulary_source/ produces the data/vocabulary/*.jsonl files described here; only raw_vocabulary_tags_public.jsonl is committed.

datasets.origin: https://huggingface.co/datasets/JayxMay95/danbooru-tags-JayMay/resolve/main/tags.jsonl (194,431 rows fetched 2026-08-06). Row count is identical to https://huggingface.co/datasets/qdlabs/danbooru-tags (Sept 2025) -- the two datasets appear same-origin; both cited here.
datasets.attribution: JayxMay95 (Hugging Face) / qdlabs (Hugging Face); underlying facts originate from Danbooru (danbooru.donmai.us).
datasets.transformation: tools/vocabulary_source/src/import_hf_tags.ts: maps name -> tag, post_count -> popularity (superseded by hf-fresh-popularity-overlay), category int -> name via the Danbooru category enum (0 general, 1 artist, 3 copyright, 4 character, 5 meta; unmapped values throw). Drops is_deprecated:true rows. Deduplicated by tag name: the upstream file repeats 33,925 tag names in 2-6 byte-identical rows, and a same-name row with differing values throws HfTagConflictError. 194,431 raw rows -> 153,258 unique tags. Rows with category 1 are kept as artist tags.
datasets.notes: This dataset's post_count is stale (1girl 6,858,776 versus 8,243,826 live on 2026-08-06), so it supplies only the tag and category universe.

datasets.origin: https://huggingface.co/datasets/u-haru/danbooru-tags-20260518 (post-level data, 115 parquet shards, ~5 GB, post ids 1-11,403,815, snapshot dated 2026-05-18).
datasets.license: Not explicitly declared on the dataset card; treated as factual/derived Danbooru post metadata (tag co-occurrence counts), consistent with how the tag-table sources above are treated. Not creative content.
datasets.attribution: u-haru (Hugging Face); underlying facts originate from Danbooru (danbooru.donmai.us).
datasets.transformation: tools/vocabulary_source/scripts/aggregate_fresh_popularity.py counts posts per tag over every shard's `tag_string`, excluding posts with `is_deleted` set, matching Danbooru's own post_count. The resulting tag/post_count JSONL is overlaid onto hf-tag-table-universe by exact tag name (merge_sources.ts popularity_overlay). 963,262 tags aggregated; 150,057 of the 153,258 universe tags (98.0%) receive a fresh count and the remaining 3,201 keep the hf-tag-table-universe count.

redistribution.reason: Aggregated factual counts (post-per-tag), not the underlying post content or images; derived from Danbooru's own public post metadata.

datasets.notes: The snapshot's 1girl count is 7,477,611; live-danbooru-top-tag-supplement refreshes the highest-traffic tags.

datasets.origin: https://danbooru.donmai.us/tags.json, live fetch performed 2026-08-06, `search[order]=count` pagination cursored on post_count, top 60,000 tags by live popularity.
datasets.license: Danbooru's public API; factual data (tag name, post_count), same treatment as hf-tag-table-universe.
datasets.transformation: One-off fetch outside the committed tools/vocabulary_source pipeline. Overlaid on the u-haru aggregation (live value wins on exact tag-name match) before the `merge` CLI's --popularity-overlay step. 1girl: 6,858,776 (universe) -> 7,477,611 (u-haru 2026-05-18) -> 8,244,995 (live 2026-08-06, shipped).

redistribution.reason: Factual data via Danbooru's public API, same basis as hf-tag-table-universe.

datasets.notes: Fetched with `search[order]=count`. tools/vocabulary_source/src/danbooru_client.ts paginates with `search[order]=id`, which Danbooru's /tags.json does not recognise; the API falls back to newest-first order and the client's ascending-id cursor stops after one page (about 1,000 tags).

datasets.origin: st-chatu8 v2.8.1 repository, tagData/danbooru_001.json..danbooru_025.json (AES-256-CBC encrypted, decrypted by tools/vocabulary_source). Archived at data/_archive/raw_st_chatu8_v2_8_1_20260804.tar.gz.
datasets.license: Aladdin Free Public License v9 (non-commercial; not an OSI-approved license). Governs the legacy st-chatu8 repository as a whole, including this bundled tagData.
datasets.transformation: Decrypted (OpenSSL-salted AES-256-CBC, EVP_BytesToKey/MD5), parsed, and mapped to VocabularyRecordSchema (record_id <- id_index, tag, translation <- translate, popularity <- hot, category fixed to "general", aliases-count field dropped). 49,856 records (49,857 minus 1 empty-tag entry), vintage ~2023.

redistribution.reason: The AFPL license governs the surrounding repository and JSON structure. The decrypted archive and raw_vocabulary_seed_full.jsonl are never committed. The source is used only as the zh translation seed (merge_sources.ts translation overlay, matched by normalized tag); facts and popularity come from hf-tag-table-universe and hf-fresh-popularity-overlay.

datasets.notes: The archive also contains tagData/tags.json and tagData/tag_NSFW001.json, which decrypt to a different shape ({ tag_groups, tag_tags }, a zh UI group tree) than the danbooru_tag shard files, not the { danbooru_tag: [...] } shape this dataset entry describes. Both remain out of scope.

datasets.origin: The `translate` field inside the legacy st-chatu8 v2.8.1 tagData shards (community-contributed zh translations of Danbooru tag names, vintage ~2023).
datasets.license: Unknown / unattributed community origin. No license or attribution trail was found for the translation strings themselves (distinct from the AFPL license on the surrounding repository).
datasets.attribution: Unknown upstream community contributor(s); not traceable from the archived repository.
datasets.transformation: Copied verbatim into the `translation` field during merge (normalized-tag match against hf-tag-table-universe). 43,543 of the 49,856 seed entries match a current tag; the rest name tags that no longer exist or were renamed.

redistribution.reason: The maintainer chose to ship these translations in apps/extension/public/vocabulary/baseline (top 50,000 by popularity, data_version 1.1.0) and in the uncommitted full pack (package_id tavern-canvas-full-zh), and accepts responsibility for upstream licensing questions. The authorship and license of the translation strings remain unknown; this is an accepted risk, not a license clearance.

datasets.notes: Revisit this entry and the shipped packages if upstream provenance is established or a complaint is received.

datasets.origin: Danbooru (danbooru.donmai.us) public tags.json / tag_aliases.json API endpoints, via tools/vocabulary_source/src/danbooru_client.ts + fetch_danbooru.ts (the fetch-danbooru CLI command).
datasets.license: Factual data (tag names, post counts, category, alias relationships) obtained via Danbooru's public API. Not creative content.
datasets.transformation: id-cursor paginated fetch (search[id]=>N, search[order]=id, limit=1000, search[post_count]=>=MIN), rate-limited (>=150ms between requests), explicit descriptive User-Agent required per Danbooru API etiquette. Mapped to VocabularyRecordSchema (record_id <- tag id, tag <- name, category <- Danbooru category enum name, popularity <- post_count, aliases <- active tag_aliases).

redistribution.reason: Factual data via a public API.

datasets.notes: The fetch-danbooru CLI is not used to build the current raw_vocabulary_tags_public.jsonl; see live-danbooru-top-tag-supplement for its pagination defect.
